app.name: clipbuf
list.empty: Copy text in another app and it will appear here.
list.transferPlain: Copy the text only, formatting dropped (no text transforms)
list.transferRaw: Copy exactly as captured, formatting kept (no text transforms)
warning.hasStyle.hint: HTML or RTF formatting accompanies this text. Pasting may carry fonts and colors.
warning.edgeWhitespace.hint: The text starts or ends with spaces or line breaks.
warning.hasTab.hint: Tab characters may render differently or trigger indentation.
warning.platformDependent.hint: Contains vendor-specific characters (NEC/IBM extensions) that may not display everywhere.
warning.controlOrBinary.hint: Contains control characters or replacement characters; the text may be corrupted.
warning.mixedNewlines.hint: CRLF, LF and/or CR are mixed.
warning.encodingNotice.hint: Byte-order mark, bidirectional controls, or mixed NFC/NFD normalization.
transfer.keepStyle.hint: Applies only to items with formatting. Text transforms are skipped for those.
notice.transformsSkipped: Formatting kept; text transforms were not applied
notice.writeFailed: Could not write to the clipboard
capture.unavailable: No clipboard is available in this session; nothing can be captured.
capture.limitedXWayland: Wayland without data-control: only copies from X11/XWayland apps are captured.
capture.denied: Clipboard access is denied. Allow clipbuf under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Pasteboard.
settings.title: Settings
settings.hotkey.unavailable: This hotkey cannot be registered. The previous one is still active.
transfer.title: Transfer options
preview.truncated: Preview truncated to the first 20,000 characters.
settings.hotkey.needsModifier: A global hotkey needs at least one modifier (Command, Control, Alt or Shift).
settings.tabWidth.hint: Used by the "tabs → spaces" transfer option.
transfer.style.hint: Whether HTML/RTF formatting travels with the text.
transfer.newline.hint: What happens to line breaks: keep them, delete them, or turn each one into a space.
transfer.trim.hint: Removes spaces (including full-width and no-break spaces), tabs and line breaks at the very start and end.
transfer.tabsToSpaces.hint: Replaces each tab with the number of spaces set in Settings.
transfer.fullwidthToSpace.hint: Replaces each full-width space (U+3000) with a normal space.
settings.previewWrap: Wrap long lines in the preview
settings.previewWrap.hint: Off shows each line as one line, scrolling sideways instead.
update.failed: The update could not be installed.
about.title: About clipbuf
about.tagline: See, stop and fix what you are about to paste.
about.privacy: Captured items stay in memory: they are never written to disk or sent anywhere. The update check is the only network access.
